name: Mikage
source:
Mikage is the timid twin sister of [url=/c10502]Nozomi[/url]. When [url=/c10490]Kei[/url] came to Hemidzuka, these twin oni appeared at her side with the ringing of bells. They hold the power to manipulate dreams, and are the direct antagonists of [url=/c10497]Yumei[/url].

[Taken from [url=http://akaiitotranslation.com/info/characters/nozomi.php]Zohar's site[/url].]
